title: Desk Answers on Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44): Lapse Notice Days by the Form a Term Is Written to Back
content:
**What adds these days?** On a lapse SR-26 under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), sent for a certificate whose backing term was cancelled and has since been reinstated with a lapse, lapse form notice days are added to the lapse run-off.

**Which record decides them?** The certificate form the backing term is written to back. This is the financial responsibility filing recorded on the Owner Auto Policy term or the Named Non-Owner Policy term, and it reads FR-44, SR-22 or none.

**How many days are added?**

| Form the backing term is written to back | Days added |
|---|---|
| FR-44 | 3 days |
| SR-22 | 1 day |
| none | no days |

**Is the reading taken from the certificate or from the term?** From the term's own record of the form it is written to back.

**Hypothetical:** a Named Non-Owner Policy term recorded as written to back an SR-22 adds 1 day. An Owner Auto Policy term recorded as backing none adds no days under this rule.
